name: Ogai's Notes
descriptionTemplate: At the start of battle, Shuffle a {Forbidden Truth} into the deck. Draw +[Arg1] each turn. After playing a Command Card, randomly grant {Perception Warp} to [Arg2] Command Cards each in your hand, draw pile, and discard pile.
lore: The record contains 70 Mason prime numbers.
